## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. E.g. *I'm always frustrated when [...]*.

## Proposed Solution / Feature
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it fits into the NityaGeeta ecosystem.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Architecture / Implementation Notes
If known, mention relevant components (e.g., FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, Weaviate vector retrieval, Redis caching, Memory Graph).

## Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or references to scriptural datasets here.
